name: NeoAnki2
subtitle: Study with spaced repetition
description:
Build a study library that works the way you think. NeoAnki2 is a native flashcard and spaced-repetition app for iPhone and iPad.

Create your own study items with text, cloze deletions, images, audio, and video. Organize them into decks and choose how each card presents its question and answer. Guided builders help you prepare vocabulary, poems, and prose for practice.

Study at your own pace with adaptive spaced repetition. Review answers, grade your recall, and record spoken responses. Keep track of due cards, set optional daily reminders, and use the Due Cards widget to return to your study library.

Your library works offline. Optional iCloud sync keeps supported library content, media, and imported vocabulary packs in your private Apple iCloud database. Pack catalogs sync across your devices; download dictionary files when you need them for offline use. Import and export NeoAnki2 deck files to move your work between devices.

Free to use, with no ads or tracking. No NeoAnki2 account is required.

NeoAnki2 uses its own native card and deck formats. It does not import Anki .apkg files or HTML/CSS card templates.
reviewNotes:
NeoAnki2 1.0.0 (build 3)

Build 3 includes current iOS/shared fixes and optional private-iCloud vocabulary-pack transfer. With iCloud sync enabled, installed packs upload automatically; other devices fetch their catalog and download files only when the user chooses Download. Downloaded packs work offline. Removing a local pack keeps iCloud copies and saved cards.

1. Physical-device demonstration
Video: NeoAnki2-physical-device-demo.mp4 (149 seconds), previously submitted build 1 on a real iPhone 13, iOS 27.0.1; recorded via iPhone Mirroring/OBS. This prior-build clip shows the basic study flow, not build 3, its new pack transfer, or its TestFlight install. It shows launch from the app icon, opening the Basic editor and cancelling, Home > Start Studying > Show Answer > Good, Undo, End, and Settings with optional iCloud/reminder controls. It uses an existing on-device library with user-entered poetry; a fresh install has an empty library. Authoring is cancelled because mirrored keyboard entry was unavailable.
Edits: cropped to portrait; Home Screen widget masked; idle seconds 42–135 and muted audio removed; app interactions retained.
No NeoAnki2 account creation/login/deletion exists. No public feed, messaging, profiles, or hosted sharing exists. Users can export their own files through the system file picker. No paid features, subscriptions, purchases, or payment flows exist.

2. Purpose and audience
This free, ad-free education app helps learners organize vocabulary, poems/prose, and their own material, then retain it through recall practice and adaptive spaced repetition. Native text/media authoring and customizable cards support offline study.

3. Setup and features
No app login, credential, sample file, network, or permission is needed for text-card study. First launch is empty with Basic/Cloze item types; screenshots show examples created in the app.
Create > New Item: choose Basic, leave Deck Unassigned, enter Front and Back, tap Save. Home > Start Studying > Show Answer > Good. Library shows the saved item. iPhone uses bottom tabs; iPad uses the sidebar.
Create also offers New Deck, Item Types & Card Setups, Import or Export, Deck Builders, and Vocabulary Packs. Items support text/cloze and user-supplied images/audio/video; study includes reveal, typed, and spoken interactions. Reminders/widgets are optional. Import supports .neodeck/.neoanki and supported JSON/CSV; optional .neovocab packs support private iCloud transfer. Anki .apkg and HTML/CSS templates are unsupported.
iCloud is initially off: Settings > Enable iCloud Sync > Create Backup & Enable requires the user's signed-in Apple iCloud account. Optional media/reminder permissions are requested when used. Saved spoken responses stay local.

4. External services/tools
Core storage/scheduling use local SQLite and Swift. Optional Apple CloudKit syncs supported library data, item/reference media, and dictionary packs through the user's private database. Apple frameworks provide local media recording/playback, prose tokenization, and media/file pickers; UserNotifications supplies local reminders; WidgetKit/App Group supplies local aggregate due data. GitHub Pages hosts privacy/support. No developer backend, AI/speech service, third-party login, payments, analytics, or tracking SDK is used.

5. Regions
Features and the empty initial library are consistent across regions. No geographic feature unlock or regional catalogue exists. Device settings control date/number formatting. Optional iCloud depends on Apple's account/service availability; local text study works offline.

6. Regulated/third-party material
No medical, financial, legal, gambling, or similar regulated service is provided. No commercial study-content, book/poem/music/movie/dictionary catalogue is bundled or streamed. Video poetry is user-entered library material, not preloaded app content. Scheduling uses a native Swift port of BSD-3-Clause fsrs-rs, not a hosted service. No Anki software is bundled.
